title: The Young Adults' Experiences With Virtual Reality (YAES VR) Study
official: The Young Adults' Experiences With Virtual Reality (YAES VR) Study
summary: The purpose of this study is to test the effect of virtual reality (VR) food marketing exposure (versus VR non-food control) on snack consumption, purchase intention, hunger, and arousal in black and white young adults. Participants will be randomized to either the VR food marketing condition or VR non-food control. Study participation duration will be 2 hours during a one-time, single visit.
